parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Number of items per page in a paginated query. The maximum is 100, and the default is 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-test-tasks --service-id service-062ae8e13b394dd5b63c --service-version draft --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --filter '[{"Value":["value1"],"Name":"Status"}]' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
